QuestInfo.name: The Lost Piece of Crack
QuestInfo.0: If I ever lose the piece of cracked dimension, then I better go see Mr. Bouffon again.
QuestInfo.1: I told #rMr. Bouffon#k that I lost the piece of cracked dimension. He told me he was going to give me another chance and that I should go see #rFlo#k immediately.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to regain the lost piece of dimension from Flo. I should seriously take care of Papulatus this time.

yes.0: Alright. I may not be blessed with many abilities, so you may need to talk to #bFlo#k, who's at the left side of the Path of Time.

no.0: You don't want to take another crack on the challenge. I know it's not easy taking on Papulatus.

0.0: Oh, no! Have you really lost the #t4031179#? That's a valuable and rare item... You can't summon Papulatus without it. What should we do now? Do you really want to give it another shot?

1.0: I heard about what happened through Mr. Bouffon. You lost your cracked piece of dimension? I'll give you my cracked piece right now.

yes.0: How do I have cracked pieces of dimension? That's a secret, kind of like magic. Please drop by every once in a while.
yes.1: Bringing people's hearts together is an incredible magic in and of itself. Hee hee hee. Would you like to see a different magic? If so, please feel free to visit me any time.

npc.0: #bFlo#k is at the entrance towards #bWarped Path of Time#k
